name: the hook count includes disabled hooks
description: GET /api/webhook/hooks answers every configured hook, disabled ones included, which is what tells 'no hooks yet' from 'hooks that are all switched off' — two states a setup check has to describe differently and that stats.activeWebhooks reports identically as 0. The seeded state has two hooks, one disabled, so a response of 1 here would mean this endpoint had been collapsed into the other one.
